summary: Builds citation text for research sources: a full reference line and a short key.
purpose: Lets the model show where its research numbers came from.
why: Likely reason: the valuation tab says citations are provided, and this code supplies them.
how: 1. Formats the access date as month, day and year. 2. Joins author, title, publisher, access date and link into one line. 3. For a short key, joins author, year and topic with underscores.
inputs: Author name, title, web address, date accessed, publisher (default Stern School of Business, NYU), year and topic.
outputs: A citation line and a short key.
risks: The output is labelled APA-style but is a simplified form, not a full APA citation. Passing text instead of a date will cause an error. The Damodaran module builds its own citation, so the two formats may differ.
debug: If a citation shows the wrong date, check the date passed in. If an error mentions date formatting, the value is not a date. If citation formats differ between files, compare with the Damodaran citation.
